note.question: Are prices higher for larger quantities?
note.overview: This paper studies a microprocessor company selling short-life-cycle products to a set of buyers that includes large consumer electronic goods manufacturers. The seller has a limited capacity for each product and negotiates with each buyer for the price. The paper's analysis of their sales data reveals that larger purchases do not always result in bigger discounts.
